label: Lindholm & Kaya, employment and tenancy law
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Libre+Caslon+Text:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
  /* Lindholm & Kaya: two partners and two associates in Cologne who act for employees and tenants. Full-width bands
     on a 76rem grid: the hero with the deadline check, the practice areas, the lawyers, how a mandate works, the fees,
     the consultation request and the questions. Libre Caslon over IBM Plex Sans, labels in IBM Plex Mono. */
  #in-law {
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.008 95);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.02 160);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.005 95);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(0.99 0.005 95);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.945 0.01 100);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.02 160);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.02 160 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.02 160 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.38 0.07 165);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.008 95);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.02 150);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.05 165);
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.012 110);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.375rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --lk-band: oklch(0.95 0.012 100);
    --lk-stamp: oklch(0.47 0.15 25);
    --lk-note: oklch(0.42 0.02 260);
    --lk-head: 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif;
    --lk-head-weight: 400;
    --lk-label: 'IBM Plex Sans', var(--font-sans);
    --lk-gutter: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
    color-scheme: light;
    container: in-law / inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.65 'IBM Plex Sans',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] {
    --background: oklch(0.99 0.002 260);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 265);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.96 0.006 260);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.02 265);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.02 265 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.2 0.02 265 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.45 0.14 265);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.002 260);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.02 265);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.1 265);
    --accent: oklch(0.955 0.01 265);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --lk-band: oklch(0.965 0.006 260);
    --lk-stamp: oklch(0.45 0.14 265);
    --lk-note: oklch(0.45 0.14 265);
    --lk-head: 'IBM Plex Sans', var(--font-sans);
    --lk-head-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='paper'] {
    --background: oklch(0.955 0.025 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.01 60);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.012 90);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.012 90);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.025 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.43 0.03 70);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.01 60 / 0.16);
    --input: oklch(0.2 0.01 60 / 0.32);
    --primary: oklch(0.24 0.01 60);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.97 0.02 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.91 0.03 85);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.28 0.02 60);
    --accent: oklch(0.925 0.03 85);
    --radius: 0.125rem;
    --lk-band: oklch(0.935 0.03 82);
    --lk-stamp: oklch(0.52 0.19 28);
    --lk-note: oklch(0.52 0.19 28);
    --lk-label: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
  }
  #in-law [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #in-law :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: var(--lk-head);
    font-weight: var(--lk-head-weight);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-law :is(a, button, summary, input, select, textarea):focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* the grid: full-width bands, the content on one 76rem column */
  #in-law > .lk-band {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem) max(var(--lk-gutter), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-law > .lk-band[data-tone='alt'] {
    background: var(--lk-band);
  }
  #in-law .lk-label {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-law .mk-section-header {
    max-width: none;
    margin-block-end: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    padding-inline: 0;
  }
  #in-law .mk-section-header-eyebrow {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-law .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 1.3rem + 1.8vw, 2.6rem);
    font-weight: var(--lk-head-weight);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  #in-law .mk-section-header-desc {
    max-width: 42rem;
  }
  /* the header */
  #in-law .lk-header {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-inline: max(var(--lk-gutter), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 92%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  #in-law .lk-header .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #in-law .lk-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #in-law .lk-monogram {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.6rem;
    height: 2.6rem;
    border: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--primary);
    font:
      400 1rem/1 'Libre Caslon Text',
      Georgia,
      serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #in-law .lk-brand span:last-child {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  #in-law .lk-brand b {
    font:
      400 1.3rem/1 'Libre Caslon Text',
      Georgia,
      serif;
  }
  #in-law .lk-brand small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-law .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-law .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link[aria-current] {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  #in-law .mk-header-actions .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-law .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-law .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 70rem) {
    #in-law .mk-header-nav {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-law .mk-header-menu {
      display: inline-flex;
    }
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 32rem) {
    #in-law .lk-brand small,
    #in-law .lk-monogram {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-law .lk-brand b {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  }
  /* the hero: the promise beside the deadline check */
  #in-law .lk-hero {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-hero h1 {
    margin: 1rem 0 1.25rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 1.5rem + 3.2vw, 4rem);
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] .lk-hero h1 {
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }
  #in-law .lk-hero h1 em {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-law .lk-lead {
    max-width: 36rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #in-law .lk-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-block-start: 2rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-facts {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 2rem;
    margin: 2.25rem 0 0;
    padding: 1.25rem 0 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    list-style: none;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-facts li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-facts svg {
    width: 1.1rem;
    height: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  /* the deadline check: a card with a stamp on it */
  #in-law .lk-check {
    display: grid;
    overflow: visible;
    position: relative;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -40px oklch(0.2 0.02 160 / 0.45);
  }
  #in-law .lk-check h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-check > p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-result {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.125rem;
    border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--primary);
    background: var(--muted);
    border-radius: 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0;
  }
  #in-law .lk-result output {
    font-family: var(--lk-head);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #in-law .lk-result small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fine {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-stamp {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1.4rem -1rem auto auto;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem 0.45rem;
    border: 3px double var(--lk-stamp);
    border-radius: 0.3rem;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--card) 88%, transparent);
    color: var(--lk-stamp);
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    line-height: 1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    rotate: 7deg;
  }
  #in-law .lk-stamp b {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  #in-law .lk-stamp small {
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] .lk-stamp {
    inset: 1.25rem 1.25rem auto auto;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
    rotate: none;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] .lk-stamp b {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='paper'] .lk-stamp {
    border-width: 2px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-radius: 0;
    rotate: -6deg;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
    background: transparent;
  }
  .dark #in-law[data-look='paper'] .lk-stamp {
    mix-blend-mode: normal;
  }
  /* the margin note: a pencilled remark beside a block */
  #in-law .lk-note {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-start: 1.6rem;
    color: var(--lk-note);
    font:
      italic 400 1rem/1.4 'Libre Caslon Text',
      Georgia,
      serif;
    rotate: -1.5deg;
  }
  #in-law .lk-note::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0.65rem auto auto 0;
    width: 1.1rem;
    height: 0;
    border-block-start: 1.5px solid currentColor;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] .lk-note {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--lk-note);
    border-radius: 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0;
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
    font:
      500 0.9375rem/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans',
      sans-serif;
    rotate: none;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='modern'] .lk-note::before {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='paper'] .lk-note {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-style: normal;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    text-decoration: underline 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--lk-note) 45%, transparent);
    text-underline-offset: 0.3em;
    rotate: -2deg;
  }
  /* practice areas: two columns, each topic with its deadline */
  #in-law .lk-areas {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-area h3 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    padding-block-end: 0.75rem;
    border-block-end: 2px solid var(--primary);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-area h3 span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-law .lk-area .mk-service-item {
    padding-block: 1rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-law .lk-area .mk-service-item-title {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-law .lk-deadline {
    display: block;
    margin-block-start: 0.4rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-law .lk-deadline::before {
    content: 'Deadline · ';
    color: var(--lk-stamp);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-law .lk-deadline[data-kind='watch']::before {
    content: 'Watch out · ';
  }
  /* the lawyers */
  #in-law .lk-team {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-law[data-look='chambers'] :is(.lk-team .mk-team-member-photo, .lk-profile-head img) {
    filter: grayscale(1);
  }
  #in-law[data-look='paper'] :is(.lk-team .mk-team-member-photo, .lk-profile-head img) {
    filter: grayscale(1) sepia(0.35);
  }
  #in-law .lk-team .mk-team-member-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-team .mk-team-member-name {
    font-family: var(--lk-head);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-team .mk-team-member-body .btn {
    justify-self: start;
    margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-team .mk-team-member-tag svg {
    width: 0.9rem;
    height: 0.9rem;
  }
  /* how a mandate works */
  #in-law .lk-how {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
    align-items: start;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-how > figure {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-law .lk-how > figure img {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #in-law .lk-how figcaption {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-law .mk-process-steps {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-law .mk-process-step-title {
    font-family: var(--lk-head);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: var(--lk-head-weight);
  }
  #in-law .mk-process-step-desc {
    max-width: 38rem;
  }
  /* the fees: a table, a margin note, insurance and legal aid */
  #in-law .lk-fees {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 15rem;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 1.5rem clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees .table-container {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees .table-head {
    font-family: var(--lk-label);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees .table-cell {
    vertical-align: top;
    padding-block: 1rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees td:first-child {
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees td:nth-child(2) {
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-family: var(--lk-head);
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees td small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees td:last-child {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-fees .lk-note {
    margin-block-start: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-help {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-help .card {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-help h3 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-help h3 svg {
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-law .lk-help p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the consultation request */
  #in-law .lk-contact {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: start;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-form {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
  }
  #in-law .lk-form fieldset {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #in-law .lk-form legend {
    margin-block-end: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-law .lk-pair {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-urgency {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-urgency label,
  #in-law .lk-slots label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.35;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #in-law .lk-urgency label:hover,
  #in-law .lk-slots label:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #in-law .lk-urgency label:has(:checked),
  #in-law .lk-slots label:has(:checked) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary);
  }
  #in-law .lk-urgency small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-slots {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 12.5rem), 1fr));
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-law .lk-slots label {
    align-items: center;
  }
  #in-law .lk-slots span {
    display: grid;
  }
  #in-law .lk-slots b {

  <section class="lk-band" id="lk-faq" aria-labelledby="lk-faq-title">
    <div class="mk-faq" data-variant="accordion">
      <div class="mk-faq-head">
        <span class="mk-faq-eyebrow">Questions</span>
        <h2 class="mk-faq-title" id="lk-faq-title">What people ask in the first call</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="mk-faq-accordion">
        <div class="accordion">
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq" open>
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>My employer dismissed me by email. Is that valid?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >No. A dismissal must be a signed letter on paper (§ 623 BGB) - email, text message and WhatsApp are
                void. Call us anyway: the employer often sends the letter a few days later, and that starts the three
                weeks.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq">
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>Do I have a right to severance pay?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >Usually not by law. Severance is what an employer pays to end a claim it might lose. A common starting
                point is half a month's gross salary per year of service - what you get depends on how strong your claim
                is.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq">
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>Should I sign the settlement agreement I was handed?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >Not on the spot. Signing it can cost you twelve weeks of unemployment benefit, and it ends any claim.
                Ask for a few days - an employer who refuses is telling you something.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq">
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>My landlord wants more rent. Do I have to agree?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >Only to an increase that is justified - up to the local comparative rent, at most 15 % in three years
                in Cologne. You have until the end of the second month after the letter arrived. Do not simply pay the
                new amount: that can count as consent.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq">
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>What should I bring to the first consultation?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >The letter and its envelope, your contract, your last three payslips - or your tenancy agreement and
                the last two service-charge statements. And a note of the day the letter arrived.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
          <details class="accordion-item" name="lk-faq">
            <summary class="accordion-trigger"
              ><span>Do you take cases outside Cologne?</span
              ><svg
                class="accordion-chevron"
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                stroke-width="2"
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg
            ></summary>
            <div class="accordion-content"
              ><p
                >Yes. We appear before every labour court in Germany, and most of the work runs by phone and video. A
                tenancy case is heard by the local court where the flat is.</p
              ></div
            >
          </details>
        </div>
